bundled.name: KANJIDIC2 and JMnedict
bundled.trigger: Only when the learner imports the files themselves.
bundled.copyright: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
bundled.attribution: KANJIDIC2 and JMnedict are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, and are used in conformance with the Group's licence (https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html).

bundled.name: CC-CEDICT

bundled.name: Kanjium pitch accent data
bundled.trigger: Downloaded automatically on first start.
bundled.attribution: Pitch accent data from Kanjium by Uros O., licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

bundled.name: Tatoeba example sentences
bundled.trigger: 706 grammar examples are compiled into the app; the full Japanese export downloads on request, and sentence search asks tatoeba.org when used.
bundled.attribution: Example sentences from the Tatoeba Project (https://tatoeba.org), licensed CC BY 2.0 FR. Each sentence keeps its Tatoeba ID.

bundled.name: Russian Wiktionary extract (kaikki.org / wiktextract)
bundled.trigger: Downloaded on request (Russian).

bundled.name: FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018), Chinese and Russian
bundled.trigger: Downloaded on first use for the language being studied.
bundled.attribution: Word frequency lists by Hermit Dave, FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018), content licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

bundled.name: JPDB v2.2 frequency list
